messages:
alex g: quick heads-up — found a regression in eu1 embeddings after the canary. failing ~0.3% of requests, looks like quant path edge case. planning a hotpatch in the late window; need expedited approvals.
jen (oncall): what are rollback criteria? we should be conservative.
maria chen: can you summarize the patch and impact on latency/cost?
alex g: patch = small guard on fused quant lookup + regenerate tokenizer cache. negligible perf change in perf tests (~0.2ms median). risk: if KV cache schema mismatch occurs, we need immediate rollback.
samir: logs show spike at 03:12 UTC, here's snippet:```
ERROR embeddings-service: kvcache lookup keytype mismatch
stack: ...
```
jen (oncall): OK. Decision matrix? want pinned image, manual canary to 5% then 100, but late window so opt for expedited path: bypass standard 1h canary.
alex g: propose flow: 1) pin image v2026-03-hotfix-17-eu1, 2) deploy to 10% for 6m smoke, 3) if error rate <=0.1% and latency stable, ramp to 100% over 10m. rollback if error rate >0.5% or CPU >70% sustained 2m.
maria chen: release notes stub: "hotfix: embeddings kvcache type mismatch — guard added and cache regen" — I'll post PR to relnotes once approved. link: https://go/relnotes/PR-1342
jen (oncall): I need explicit approval from SRE and product. @samir please confirm SRE ok.
samir: SRE ok with criteria. will monitor and trigger rollback if we hit threshold. +1 from me. :thumbsup:
jen (oncall): prod approves conditional on relnotes and pinned image. maria, can you push relnotes now?
maria chen: done — PR merged. adding changelog line and revert instructions.
release-bot: Deployment request created by alex g for service=embeddings-eu1 version=v2026-03-hotfix-17 image=sha256:abc123. Notifying approvers.
alex g: kicking the deploy now with --expedite flag. command:```
/deploy embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-17 --pin --expedite --canary=10% --smoke=6m
```
release-bot: deploy started: canary=10% at 1771234578. Check logs: https://go/logs/deploy/1771234567
jen (oncall): monitoring. SLO panels up.
samir: seeing canary traces — 6m in, error rate 0.02%, latency +0.1ms median. green so far.
alex g: ramping to 100% over 8m. command executed.
release-bot: ramp complete at 1771234660. traffic now at 100%.
jen (oncall): marking approval in thread. leaving note: rollback plan: `/deploy rollback embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-16` or pin older sha, and open incident channel if >5% users impacted.
maria chen: relnotes published and emailed to customers on scheduled window.
samir: closing watch — will re-open if metrics degrade.
alex g: thanks team. tagging postmortem-if-necessary but hoping no followup needed. :relieved:
